title: Could be great
body: But it’s not yet, it’s simply ‘ok’ the biggest let down is the absence of any sound when you complete a habit, some sort of animation or joyful sound would elevate this app a lot more. It’s a bit awkward to set up how you want it, and not many options to customise in any meaningful way, however it looks good, but that’s it.
author: Early Urdu

title: It’s ok
body: So I asked ChatGPT to get me an app that could get me into healthy habits. first of all you have to pay,second of all you couldn’t put your age in so it was saying don’t smoke don’t drink and I’m not old enough yet anyway I couldn’t work out how to do that stuff so idk. But if I do change my mind I will 100%💯 update you on that.bye Besties xx
author: Dog lover😝
